title: Closing Shaders stops previously edited Scenes from being saved
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.6.1-stable, 4.6.3-stable, 4.7.beta 070dc9897, 4.7.rc ec67cbe92628bdaf979b10594359ba6f02cf8838 (current master) ### System information Godot v4.7.beta (070dc9897) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.11 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Scenes with unsaved changes "forget" that they have unsaved changes when closing a Shader. Among other things this causes the unsaved changes prompt when closing Godot to not appear if no scenes are changed afterwards and if scenes are changed afterwards only those are saved (scenes that were only modified previously aren't saved). ## Before (Scene marked as unsaved) ## After (Scene no longer marked as unsaved) --- When closing a `ShaderEditor` `EditorUndoRedoManager::get_singleton()->clear_history();` is called which seems to be the cause of this https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ec67cbe92628bdaf979b10594359ba6f02cf8838/editor/shader/shader_editor_plugin.cpp#L465 > [!note] > With https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115998 merged this now only affects `VisualShaderEditor`s ### Steps to reproduce - New project - Create a scene and add any Node to it (Scene should now be marked as unsaved) - Create a Shader - Close the Shader (Scene should now no longer be marked as unsaved) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
